_comment: Candidates screened out of the final 30-paper corpus, with the reason for exclusion. Retained so the selection process is auditable and reproducible rather than opaque.

excluded.title: Solar Photovoltaic Energy Forecasting Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Technique
excluded.reason: Peer-reviewed but published in a regional IEEE section conference (UPCON 2022) with a narrow experimental scope; excluded to keep the classical-ML category at five higher-quality sources. Verified metadata is retained in literature/verification/ for audit.

excluded.title: Evaluating the Impact of Deep Learning Approaches on Solar and Photovoltaic Power Forecasting: A Systematic Review
excluded.reason: Original seed DOI guess was wrong; the title was resolved to Energy Strategy Reviews (2025) and retained as G2 under its verified DOI.

excluded.title: Transformers Applied to Short-term Solar PV Power Output Forecasting
excluded.reason: Resolves only to an arXiv preprint with no peer-reviewed version located. Excluded because the review corpus is restricted to peer-reviewed publications; transformer-family PV forecasting is instead represented by two journal articles (D1 RSER 2024, D2 Energy and AI 2024).

excluded.title: A Hybrid VMD-GRU Model for Enhanced Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
excluded.reason: Resolved to a 2025 SENZE conference paper with zero citations and no abstract available from any source. Replaced by a peer-reviewed Energy (2022) hybrid decomposition-plus-recurrent study (C5, 10.1016/j.energy.2022.124661).

excluded.title: Comparison of machine learning methods for photovoltaic power forecasting based on numerical weather prediction data
excluded.reason: Not excluded. Initially seeded twice (G4 and A1); deduplicated to a single record and classified under category A because its contribution is a controlled classical-ML comparison.
